name: V-2 MW 18014
about: An A-4 (V-2) fired straight up from Peenemunde, the first craft known to pass 100 km. GCAT lists it on 14 Sep 1944 with an apogee of 175 km (citing von Braun, 1958); 20 Jun 1944 is the date most often given. The hour is unknown.

pieces.why: on its stand at Peenemunde (GCAT site HVP); the day before is authored
about 65 s of thrust, then a coast to 175 km and the fall back; the hour is unknown, noon is a stand-in
came down in the Baltic; about seven minutes for a 175 km vertical flight

events.why: date from GCAT; the hour is unknown
